description: FairOdds demo app (Step 4) — landing + LIVE on-chain Brier track record (ForecastRegistry, devnet) + pm-AMM markets. Read-only; no wallet, no sends.
name: fairodds-app
notes: STEP 4 (Nov 21): Vite + React (chosen over Next.js for a reliable static build in this sandbox). Data route: the page renders public/data.json (produced LIVE from devnet by `npm run fetch-data`, scripts/fetch-data.cjs) and then refreshes the track record + markets in-browser over HTTPS RPC (src/lib/chain.ts). Smoke: `npm run smoke` (headless Chrome against `vite preview`).
